answer_1.quote: We aim to generate a relevant and non-generic response when given an unseen prompt.

answer_2.quote: For reference only, we include the results of the following automatic metrics for reference in Table : (1) BLEU-1 and BLEU-2 (2) Embedding Average cosine similarity (3) dist-1 and dist-2

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is the only reliable way to evaluate this task. Following the standards of , for each model, we randomly sample 500 pairs from our test set, and each pair is rated by 3 distinct crowdsourcing workers.
answer_4.guideline: We ask them to rate 1) informativeness and specificity of each response and 2) if the response is on topic (relevance), on a Likert scale from 0 to 3.
